name: pulsetube-ai
description: YouTube Playlist and Video lectures summarizer for exams and interview

paragraphs: PulseTube AI is a full-stack web application built for university students revising video lectures before exams and developers preparing for technical interviews. Instead of watching hours of long lectures, PulseTube AI extracts spoken transcripts, fetches course metadata via the YouTube Data API v3, and uses Google Gemini / Gemma 3 / Groq LLMs to teach the actual concepts, working code examples, formulas, exam questions, and interview flashcards inside any video or 200-video playlist.
features: 📚 Deep Lecture Notes & Working Code Examples: Explains every core concept, under-the-hood mechanism, mathematical formula, and working code snippet (Java/Spring, Python, C++, SQL) step by step, paired with clickable…
🎓 University Exam Revision Mode: Generates last-minute exam cheat sheets, common student exam traps to avoid, and practice university exam questions with expandable full-credit model answers.

💼 Technical Interview Prep & Active-Recall Flashcards: Structures topics into 30-Second Elevator Pitches, Technical Deep-Dives, Production Trade-Off Matrices, and interactive flip flashcards with mastery tracking.

🗂️ 200-Video Playlist Support & Playback Speed Calculator: Fetches full course playlists (40–200+ videos) via paginated YouTube Data API v3 calls, computes exact watch-time savings across 1x, 1.25x, 1.5x, 1.75x, and 2x…
📄 One-Click Study Guide Exports: Exports complete lecture notes, code blocks, and Q&As to Markdown (.md) and printable PDF (.pdf) reports.
